decision.reason: [ev-48d8875989c1] calls the setting the `defaultRuleSyntax` static option. Nothing shown proves that the Helm chart exposes it at the values path `core.defaultRuleSyntax`. That option, or the per-route `syntax` field added to IngressRoute and IngressRouteTCP [ev-08274e476e86][ev-b15a80a9b42b], could also be set through other means. The bigger problem is that, per [ev-48d8875989c1], only routers whose rules use v2-only matchers are exposed: `Headers`, regex in `PathPrefix`, multi-value matchers and non-Go regexps. So "the key is unset" flags far too many environments, and it also misses routers configured outside Helm values. To write a precise condition, I'd need evidence of the chart's values key for this option and of where router rules are configured (CRD `match` fields or other providers).
